card.name: Inside the word adjuvant
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the piece "vant" (or "ju") inside the word "adjuvant", as in adjuvant treatment or therapy. It appears in oncology labels, mostly for breast cancer drugs.

modes.label: Adjuvant heading
modes.description: The end of "adjuvant" in a section heading such as Adjuvant Treatment.
